name: Product, experience and architecture handoffs
hypothesis: Versioned experience/visual decisions and architecture boundaries should reduce lost intent. User demand and usability remain unvalidated unless actually observed.
evidence_limit: Sources establish available workflow mechanisms, not independent commercial quality or causal productivity gains. No framework code or runtime is installed.
adoption_boundary: Adapt mechanisms in the requested local candidate; no automatic source-to-required-policy promotion. Existing R3 governance review and hosted trust boundaries remain.
experiment: 22 scenario responses and 3 isolated synthetic local repository tasks; negative tests for the consistency helper. Preserve old common-case baseline.
guardrails: No weakened risk/authorization/review controls; preserve R0/R1 short path; no paid, production or external write expansion.
